subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confront
solution:
The correct answer is **'Challenge'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Confront__: To stand in front of somebody (किसी के सामने खड़ा होना****)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The unarmed demonstrators were **confronted** by a row of soldiers.
 
 
 
• __**Challenge**__**: Something new and difficult that forces you to make a lot of effort (चुनौती****)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The company will have to face many **challenges** in the coming months.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'Challenge'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mingle**__**: To mix with other things or people** **(अन्‍य वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों में घुल-मिल जाना)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- His excitement was **mingled** with fear.
 
 
 
• ​__**Conceal**__**: To hide something/somebody [(किसी से कुछ) छिपाना****]**
 __
 
• ​**E.g.__**- She tried to **conceal** her anger from her friend.
 
 
 
• __**Scheme**__**: An official plan or system for doing something (आधिकारिक योजना या प्रणाली****)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- A new **scheme** to provide houses in the area has been announced.
